designSummary: Qualitative interview study; no statistical testing.
sampleSize: Targets of 16 patients, 10 carers and 10 clinicians follow the retrieved guidance of 12 to 20 interviews per group for a narrow aim with a specific sample (c5); carers and clinicians have lower targets because their accounts are anchored to the same episodes. The targets are revisited during analysis, and recruitment stops for a group when new interviews add no new account of the pathway.
primaryAnalysis: Reflexive thematic analysis by two analysts, coding each group separately and then comparing accounts of the same episodes across patient, carer and clinician.
secondaryAnalysis: A short descriptive table of the episodes (diagnosis, time of worsening, who called, route back) from the record summaries, without inferential statistics.
missingData: Episodes where the patient declines but the carer or clinician agrees are kept and reported as partial accounts.
software: Qualitative analysis software licensed by the hospital; memo log kept by both analysts.
overfittingGuards: Themes are not counted as prevalence
Negative cases are sought and reported
The working proposition h1 is treated as a lens, not a result
summary: About 36 interviews guided by information power; reflexive thematic analysis.
